statement: Solve $\dfrac{dy}{dx}+y=0$ with $y(0)=1$, and verify your solution satisfies the equation.
solution: Separating: $\dfrac{dy}{y}=-dx\Rightarrow \ln|y|=-x+C\Rightarrow y=Ae^{-x}$. With $y(0)=1$, $A=1$, so $y=e^{-x}$. Check: $y'+y=-e^{-x}+e^{-x}=0$ and $y(0)=1$.
